chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: Hearing Diz and Bird before New York; Bird at the Rum Boogie breakfast dances
summary: Jones knew Dizzy on radio and Bird on records and in Chicago breakfast dances; Merl Young fired Bird from his band.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Uh-huh. When you first arrived at the Onyx Club in 1949 -- no, 1944, excuse me. Was the music on the street familiar to you? Had you heard Diz and Bird before you got to New York?
Oh, yes. Diz, Bird, Art Tatum.
Where had you heard them? You heard Tatum in Chicago, but where had you heard Diz and Bird?
Well, on the radio, when Diz was working with Cab.
Uh-huh.
And heard Bird on records.
I see.
Oh, no. Gee whiz, I used to hang out with
Bird on the South Side, at breakfast dances.
When was that?

That was before I went to New York. I was with Stuff, working on Randolph Street, and Bird was playing in a band at a club called the Rum Boogie, and they would go on Saturday nights, they would play the breakfast dances, you know. It would start maybe about 9:00 o'clock, going into church time, Sunday morning. And guys would start jamming.
Uh-huh.
You know, and they would play, 'Cherokee,' until 3:00 o'clock in the afternoon, when church was over.
(Laughter)
What band was it that Bird was playing in at the Rum Boogie?
Merl Young's band.
Oh.

And Eddie Johnson, another friend of mine who was in the trio, a singing trio, he used to always kid Merl. He says, 'Well, you've got one great thing going for you. You're the only one in the world that ever fired Charlie Parker.'
(Laughter)
Why did Merl fire Bird?
I don't know. I just knew he fired him. I don't know why he fired him. And Bird was living around
Uh-huh. So that was around '42, '43?
Yeah, somewhere around there. He had just left Jay McShann (PHONETIC) in Kansas City. He left that part of the country and he had settled in Chicago and went from Chicago to New York, you know?
